page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.16xlarge is a high-density, compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture using dedicated AMD EPYC 7T83 processors. Running on a KVM hypervisor at a clock speed of 2.55 GHz, this server features 32 physical cores across 64 virtual CPUs with 2 threads per core. System memory is configured with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio equal to 2.0 GB per core. The instance includes 32 MB of L3 cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache per core, and 32 KB of L1d cache. It does not include local disk storage or discrete GPU accelerators, requiring external block storage for persistent data, but provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark testing demonstrates high compute capabilities across multi-threaded and cryptographic tasks. The ecs.c7a.16xlarge achieves top-tier results in stress-ng single-core and multi-core performance, as well as PassMark CPU, extended instructions, and encryption tests. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and cached memory bandwidth tests reached the top 25% percentile, while uncached memory bandwidth read and write benchmarks performed in the middle 50% range. Advanced CPU instructions include AVX, AES, VAES, SHA_NI, BMI2, ADX, FMA, and secure execution mitigations like IBRS and SSBD, though AVX-512 extensions are absent.

In application-level performance evaluations, the instance showed notable efficiency in memory-bound in-memory data structures and lightweight inferencing. Redis SET operations peaked at 61.81 million operations per second, placing in the top quartile, alongside high relative PassMark database operation scores. For small 135M parameter language model inference, prompt processing reached 2865.39 tokens per second and generation reached 273.43 tokens per second. Media processing tests such as Geekbench ray tracing and image processing also scored in the top 25%, making the instance cost-effective for intensive compute tasks, software compilation, parallel batch processing, and high-concurrency memory-backed service architectures.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance driven by a 32-core AMD EPYC 7T83 processor yielding 64 vCPUs at 2.55 GHz under a KVM hypervisor. Equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM (2.0 GB per core) and 16 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, it relies entirely on remote block storage due to the absence of onboard disks or GPU accelerators. Hardware acceleration includes AVX, AES, VAES, SHA_NI, and FMA instruction sets. In benchmark testing, the server excels in multi-threaded processor throughput, PassMark CPU evaluation, cached memory access, and bzip3 decompression, landing in the top 25% of tested systems. Application workloads show strong performance in Redis SET operations exceeding 61 million operations per second and rapid token processing for small-scale language models. This instance delivers effective resource density for CPU-bound computation, multi-threaded batch jobs, software compilation, and high-throughput web operations.
og_description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.16xlarge features 64 AMD EPYC vCPUs, 128 GB RAM, and 16 Gbps network bandwidth. It excels in multi-threaded CPU tasks, Redis key-value workloads, and small model LLM inference.

tagline: High-density 64-vCPU AMD EPYC compute instance offering balanced memory density, strong multi-core processing, and elevated network throughput for intensive workloads.

128 GB system memory delivering a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM compute-optimized ratio
16 Gbps baseline network bandwidth and KVM-based virtualization without local disks
Top-tier multi-core performance in stress-ng, PassMark CPU, and Redis SET workloads
